identity:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production 2D hand-painted RPG character animation sprite atlas, genuine transparent RGBA background.
Create ONE exceptionally polished sprite sheet, EXACTLY SIX equal-width columns by FIVE equal-height rows (30 full-body sprites total), landscape canvas 3072 x 2560 if possible. No captions, no letters, no grid lines, no frame numbers, no background, no checkerboard painted into art, no contact shadows.
IDENTITY in EVERY frame: same adult male warrior of Yunhua, a Chinese-inspired fantasy nation. Refined heroic handsome face, dark brows, black hair in compact high topknot with jade clasp; teal-blue cloth tunic under exquisitely rendered dark lacquer lamellar chest armor, small antique gold cloud-engraved pauldrons, cream inner sleeves, burgundy waist sash and short waist panels, fitted dark trousers, brown leather boots, leather bracers. Approximately 5.5 heads tall, stylized illustrated premium JRPG hero, painterly color gradients, crisp controlled outlines, readable appealing silhouette; not voxel, not low-poly, not 3D render, not photoreal. He holds ONE elegant single-edged Chinese ring-pommel dao saber, silver blade with subtle blue edge, gold guard and dark hilt. Empty left hand. Never add a shield or second weapon.
CAMERA: full-body side-battle three-quarter view, faces RIGHT in every frame. Same perspective, scale, face, costume, sword length, lighting and body proportions in ALL thirty cells. His standing height occupies 65 percent of each cell so sword and poses fit safely. Each frame centered horizontally inside its own cell, heels baseline at 85 percent cell height. Preserve empty 8 percent margins. No figure, blade, fabric or effects cross cell boundaries. Render each pose freshly and anatomically, do not paste a single pose. The complete blade must remain visible and connected correctly to right hand.
ANIMATION rows, left-to-right chronological SIX KEY POSES EACH:
ROW 1 IDLE LOOP: relaxed ready stance, saber angled down-forward; gentle breath inhale, shoulders rise, subtle tunic and sash lag, exhale, return; tiny changes only. Frame 6 returns to frame 1.
ROW 2 ATTACK: combat ready; weighted knees bend with torso twisting and saber drawn back high; forceful step and early diagonal slash; fully extended slash cutting down-forward to the right with thin restrained blade trail; follow-through blade low; recover to ready. Obvious anticipation/contact/followthrough, convincing transfer of body weight, feet stay within cell.
ROW 3 HIT REACTION: ready; sharp chest recoil from a blow arriving from right; torso leans back and left hand tightens at chest; knees bend recovering balance; regain balance; ready. Non-graphic, no wounds or blood, no attacker.
ROW 4 PARRY: ready; lift saber diagonally across upper body; brace and meet incoming strike with right saber and left palm bracing right forearm; stronger braced impact and tiny amber glint on blade; lower guard; ready. Only the same single saber, no shield.
ROW 5 DODGE: ready; lower center of gravity; lean torso far backward away from right with bent knees; deep evasive crouch toward left, cloth follows; spring back upright; ready.
All rows use exact same cell grid dimensions. Production-worthy detailed cloth folds, gold ornaments and face shading, consistent anatomy, logical hands and weapon. Prioritize beautiful individually drawn frames and coherent animation. Transparent empty pixels surrounding every sprite.
